mechanism.claim: When a completed four-hour BTC auction strictly engulfs both boundaries of the preceding disjoint four-hour range yet closes in one outer quartile with an agreeing body, the two-sided liquidity sweep has resolved into accepted price discovery. Follow that accepted direction for eight hours during elevated realized variation.
mechanism.side: long for upper-quartile bullish acceptance and short for lower-quartile bearish acceptance
mechanism.why_distinct: Break-retest acceptance crosses one prior boundary and retests it; range traversal orders absolute daily extrema; wick imbalance compares aggregate tails; close-location rules use one range without a prior-range engulfment requirement. HVEAAR requires a later disjoint auction to sweep both prior boundaries and resolve at one extreme with agreeing body, using no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, fitted outcome, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the combined completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily two-sided sweep-resolution clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.strict_engulfment: engulfing high>prior high and engulfing low<prior low
features.close_location: (engulfing close-engulfing low)/(engulfing high-engulfing low), denominator strict positive
features.long_acceptance: strict engulfment, close_location>=0.75, and engulfing close>engulfing open
features.short_acceptance: strict engulfment, close_location<=0.25, and engulfing close<engulfing open
features.ambiguity: exactly one acceptance side must hold
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns across [D-8h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: one accepted engulfing direction and variation gate pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: two-sided prior-range sweep followed by extreme same-body terminal acceptance

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no auction, engulfment, close-location, body, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
